name: start_combat
description: Begins a combat encounter for a game. Sets the initiative order and advances to round 1. Each combatant entry requires a slug, entity type, display name, and initiative roll. The turn order is sorted from highest to lowest initiative. Call advance_turn after each combatant acts.

combatants.description: All combatants entering initiative, in any order. Will be sorted by initiative descending.

entity_type.description: Whether this combatant is a player character or NPC.

name.description: Display name used in turn announcements.
